prs.author: Genmin

prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejected POST requests whose Accept header only listed application/json (without text/event-stream), returning a spurious 406 Not Acceptable. Both PRs relax the Accept-header validation in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts's request handler to allow application/json alone in JSON response mode. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 introduces a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly implements Accept-header semantics: it splits on ',' and ';', strips parameters, and honors q=0 to explicitly exclude a media type. #2046 instead does a plain acceptHeader.includes('application/json') substring check, which both ignores q=0 exclusion (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would incorrectly count as accepted) and is vulnerable to substring false-positives (e.g. a hypothetical 'application/jsonl' type would match the substring check). #1996's approach is the more spec-correct fix for the same underlying validation bug.

clusters.pick_reason: #1996 introduces a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly implements Accept-header semantics: it splits on ',' and ';', strips parameters, and honors q=0 to explicitly exclude a media type. #2046 instead does a plain acceptHeader.includes('application/json') substring check, which both ignores q=0 exclusion (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' would incorrectly count as accepted) and is vulnerable to substring false-positives (e.g. a hypothetical 'application/jsonl' type would match the substring check). #1996's approach is the more spec-correct fix for the same underlying validation bug.

members.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
members.author: Genmin
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejected POST requests whose Accept header only listed application/json (without text/event-stream), returning a spurious 406 Not Acceptable. Both PRs relax the Accept-header validation in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts's request handler to allow application/json alone in JSON response mode. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes an actual behavioral bug: after normalization pathname becomes '' (not '/') at root, so shouldAttemptFallback's `pathname === '/'` check was dead code that never short-circuited, causing redundant fallback HTTP requests at the root path — #2215 corrects this to `pathname === ''` via the shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper. #2214 (tagged chore) only changes the string-stripping in buildWellKnownPath and a second duplicated stripping block inside buildDiscoveryUrls, but never touches shouldAttemptFallback, so it leaves that root-check mismatch unfixed. Note #2214's buildDiscoveryUrls edit covers a code path #2215 doesn't touch, so that specific hunk (multiple trailing slashes on the raw url.pathname used to build urlsToTry) should be reapplied on top of #2215 if not already covered elsewhere.
